# REALTIQ combined current scope

Audit date:10October2026.

**What already works?** There is useful source implementation for accounts/KYC, property/project management/imports, maps/search, persistent messaging, payment/cart logic, instalments, dispute/refund handling, protected title sessions/hash records, proxy inspections, Matterport/Realsee adapters, trust/reviews and ROI/automated valuation. These are reusable foundations; local225-test pass does not certify providers or deployed full journeys.

**What must be corrected?** Protect contacts and documents, enforce current-account permissions, replace incorrect property/basket payment routing, lock bilateral terms and units atomically, distinguish payment from legal ownership, make escrow release correspond to real custodian movement, and unify typed data/search/fees/eligibility across both clients.

**What remains from the original agreement?** Core escrow/instalments, maps, verification/trust, proxy live inspection/signed reports, property facts/media, vault/contracts/signature, internal buyer/seller workflows, ROI/valuation/analytics and retention remain owed unless explicitly superseded. Offline/Lidar/heatmap/public-ledger/tenancy/news/blog promises need signed reconciliation; new-source omissions do not cancel paid baseline.

**What is genuinely additional?** Compare and social publishing are clear new-module candidates. Developer inheritance/bundle/shared-milestone models, agencies/seats/expanded Partner services, broad issuer/finance/recurring/tax engine and detailed ecosystem protocols are material increments needing itemised approval, with original implementation credited. Normal validation, security, errors and unfinished baseline features are not separately billed by default.

**What depends on the client/provider?** Custody/split/refund accounts and legal authority; approved fees/tax/templates/dictionaries/permissions; licences/domains/content and credentials for each launch provider; notification/verification/FX services; actual engineering/QA/operations capacity and acceptance owners. These are not solved by a payment percentage.

ApproximatelyNGN 2,550,000 agreed,NGN 1,530,000 implied paid andNGN 1,020,000 outstanding. No completion percentage or additional agreed price is inferred.31October2026 is21 calendar days away; full scope cannot responsibly be promised from this evidence.

OpenID Connect (OIDC) is the required shared sign-in protocol. An application programming interface (API) is the contract between clients/services. Know Your Customer (KYC) is identity eligibility. A transactional outbox durably records events with the data change. Recovery point/time objectives (RPO/RTO) measure allowed data loss/time to restore. Prices marked POA mean price on application, not zero. Source and deployment proof remain separate.

Entry points: src/app.js:91 captures raw Paystack callback data before JSON parsing at94; API routers are mounted97–120. index.js connects MongoDB before starting HTTP/Socket.IO and instalment/title-snapshot/marketplace-alert schedulers. src/config/db.js:8–15 creates indexes at startup. Therefore starting the server is not a read-only check and was not done. MongoDB uses MONGO_URI; the cron guide's MONGODB_URI is inconsistent. World Bank scheduler source existence is not proof it is invoked by the entry point. README scaffold and unimplemented-controller claims are stale.

A named route, a controller import or mocked pass does not prove the complete path. Strong reusable bounded parts include upload asset ownership/expiry checks (propertyController407–415), messaging participant access, title view-once compare-and-set, cart-item allocation idempotency key and pending-refund fund blocking. These do not validate all endpoints or production providers.

## Launch feasibility, critical path and shared work breakdown

Today 10October2026 leaves21 calendar days to31October2026; the target has not passed. No staffing/capacity or resolved approval schedule supplied. The current code and missing models do not support a defensible full-scope promise. Do not silently reduce launch acceptance. Replace a date promise with a proof-and-estimation milestone, decisions, integrated acceptance and an agreed capacity-based delivery plan. The frontend audit's12–20 week forecast is provisional and cannot be certified from source inspection.

Critical path: signed custody/fees/legal/identity/field decisions → canonical schema and migration design → bilateral terms/atomic unit state → money ledger/provider proof → document/legal completion → integrated frontend journeys → security/load/restore/UAT → deployment rehearsal. Search/import/Compare/media/social can progress in parallel only after stable common contracts. Adding developers does not resolve provider/counsel approval lead time.

Ranges exclude client/provider waiting, content capture, recurrent costs and audit reading; may change after isolated database/provider proof. Overlapping shared identity/ledger/notification/contract work is charged once in its owning row.

## Additional backend verification tasks and omitted detail

BE identifiers below are **tasks**, crosswalked to an existing shared product ID where applicable. They are not a second product inventory and are never added to AUD totals. T20–T26 were grouped in the source and insufficiently atomised in the earlier frontend audit; these seven typed attributes are separate verification tasks. A crosswalk identifies the closest owning requirement and does not certify semantic equivalence to its entire broad group.

| BE task | Shared primary AUD | Source / observed evidence | Correction | Acceptance | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BE-001 — Public serializers disclose other-party contacts | AUD-RQS01-0108 | RQS00 rule2–3; RQS06 section 1/12; RQS07 section 7; src/services/publicUserSerializer.js:15-16,31-32; src/services/projectService.js:355-356 | Remove other-party email/phone from every public DTO, profile/project/detail and notifications; preserve permitted own-account fields. | Anonymous/Registered/Verified snapshot schemas contain no contacts; own-account authorised view still works. | S2 |
| BE-002 — Current-account permission and token revocation | AUD-RQS01-0108 | PRD21; RQS06 sections3,4.6,19; src/middleware/authMiddleware.js:13-16; src/utils/generateToken.js:6-13; src/realtime/socketServer.js:43-51 | Check active account/profile/seat/resource on HTTP and realtime; revoke password-reset/logout/suspended/deleted tokens. | Previously issued token denied after each revocation; sockets disconnected; no stale seat access. | S2 |
| BE-003 — Payment/inquiry list role isolation | AUD-RQS01-0108 | RQS06 sections3/19; professional resource access; src/controllers/paymentController.js:348-362; src/controllers/inquiryController.js:92 | Replace default query{} for unexpected roles with deny; enforce resource ownership on list/populate/export as well as detail. | Proxy/unrelated account cannot enumerate others payments or enquiry contacts; permitted owner list exact. | S2 |
| BE-004 — Guest paid-title eligibility | AUD-RQS06-0008 | RQS06 section 3.1/13; RQS08 paid service rules; src/services/titleDocumentAccessService.js:75,132,177 | Require current Verified access before quote/init/fulfil/open; apply basket policy consistently. | Guest/Registered blocked before provider call; Verified owner-entitled case correct. | S3 |
| BE-005 — Transferred stream tokens and watermark integrity | AUD-RQS01-0108 | RQS06 section 13.3; private document safeguards; src/services/titleDocumentAccessService.js:433,478-534 | Bind entitlement/session to appropriate account and revocable policy; implement actual protected watermarking when required; prevent original URL leakage. | Copied token, revoked grant, expired session and changed title denied; protected bytes carry approved watermark. | S2 |
| BE-006 — Upload content validation, scanning and fetch isolation | AUD-RQS01-0108 | PRD21; RQS06 sections13–14; src/middleware/uploadMiddleware.js:1; src/services/titleHashService.js:43 | Validate signatures/content/limits, scan/quarantine, private storage and controlled remote fetch host/IP/redirects; avoid metadata-only MIME acceptance. | Forged MIME, malware, internal-IP URL, oversize and unsafe redirect blocked; approved file and signed expiry work. | S2 |
| BE-007 — Request bodies/private values in logs | AUD-RQS01-0108 | PRD21; private reserve/title/KYC rules; src/middleware/validators/propertyValidators.js:16; src/controllers/paymentController.js:354 | Redact sensitive payloads/provider metadata and restrict audit exports; allow correlation IDs without contacts/reserve/account details. | Representative validation/error/webhook logs contain no restricted fields. | S2 |
| BE-008 — Atomic property reservation across different buyers | AUD-RQS00-0002 | RQS01 section 12.4; RQS06 stage6; src/controllers/escrowController.js:106; src/services/installmentService.js:594; src/models/Escrow.js:74 | Move uniqueness from buyer:property to atomic unit reservation under accepted terms; expiry/release must not unlock another buyer. | Parallel different buyers: one acceptance winner, conflict loser, no double collection. | S3 |
| BE-009 — Payment capture must not complete legal ownership | AUD-RQS00-0008 | RQS06 sections5/10; RQS01 U2; src/controllers/paymentController.js:145-156; src/services/installmentService.js:864-883; src/services/escrowSettlementService.js:25-35 | Separate Paid, money release and legal completion; guard seller status patch and fulfilment. | Payment-only cannot produce Sold/Owned; legal evidence/escrow/no obligations needed. | S1 |
| BE-010 — Normal escrow release lacks provider movement | AUD-RQS00-0008 | RQS01 sections14–17; RQS08 custody; src/controllers/escrowController.js:268-286; src/services/escrowSettlementService.js:7-53 | Require approved custodian release instruction and durable confirmation before released ledger state; never fabricate provider movement. | Sandbox release then callback reconciles seller net/fee/principal; rejection keeps held state. | S1 |

- [ ] **AUD-RQS03-0070** — Escrow Available: allowed values Boolean Toggle (On / Off). Control Binary Toggle Switch. Rules Default: Off. - [ ] **AUD-RQS03-0071** — Build Stage Lifecycle: allowed values Off-plan; Under construction; Uncompleted building; Semi- finished (Advanced Shell / Lock-up); Newly built; Renovated; Previously owned; Old. Control Multi-Select Checkboxes (OR). Rules Default: Any. Unifies physical maturity into 8 lifecycle states, replacing the legacy dual controls (Completion Stage + Listing Type). Semi-finished: exterior fully sealed and secure (lock-up), first-fix plumbing and electrical conduits complete and internal surfaces plastered, with second-fix fixtures, cabinetry, internal doors and decorative finishes not yet installed; distinct from a raw carcass, which is open to the elements. Uncompleted building or Semi-finished listings that will not be completed before handover carry a “Sold as is” label; this is not a separate filter value. Multi-select (buyer filter). — FEES / P1 / S8

- [ ] **AUD-RQS03-0073** — Handover Delivery Stage: allowed values Site Preparation & Substructure: Site Clearing & Excavation; Foundation Footing; DPC (German Floor) Carcass: Blockwork / Lintel Level; Decking; Roofing / Parapet Semi- Finished: Lock-up; First-Fix Infrastructure Finishing: POP Ceiling; Tiling & Floor Finishes; Second-Fix Installation; Screeding & Painting Commissioning, External Works & Handover: External Works & Services; Snagging & Inspection; Handover. Identifies the construction milestone a development has reached across five standard Nigerian phases; selecting a phase header selects all of its milestones. These milestones commonly determine when off-plan instalments fall due (the DPC stage is almost always a major payment trigger). Milestone definitions are given below this table. — FEES / P1 / S8

Month granularity replaces the current day-level completion window. — TOUR / P1 / S1

### Additional backend verification checklist

- [ ] **BE-001** — Public serializers disclose other-party contacts; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Anonymous/Registered/Verified snapshot schemas contain no contacts; own-account authorised view still works.
- [ ] **BE-002** — Current-account permission and token revocation; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Previously issued token denied after each revocation; sockets disconnected; no stale seat access.
- [ ] **BE-003** — Payment/inquiry list role isolation; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Proxy/unrelated account cannot enumerate others payments or enquiry contacts; permitted owner list exact.
- [ ] **BE-004** — Guest paid-title eligibility; shared AUD-RQS06-0008; Guest/Registered blocked before provider call; Verified owner-entitled case correct.
- [ ] **BE-005** — Transferred stream tokens and watermark integrity; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Copied token, revoked grant, expired session and changed title denied; protected bytes carry approved watermark.
- [ ] **BE-006** — Upload content validation, scanning and fetch isolation; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Forged MIME, malware, internal-IP URL, oversize and unsafe redirect blocked; approved file and signed expiry work.
- [ ] **BE-007** — Request bodies/private values in logs; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Representative validation/error/webhook logs contain no restricted fields.
- [ ] **BE-008** — Atomic property reservation across different buyers; shared AUD-RQS00-0002; Parallel different buyers: one acceptance winner, conflict loser, no double collection.
- [ ] **BE-009** — Payment capture must not complete legal ownership; shared AUD-RQS00-0008; Payment-only cannot produce Sold/Owned; legal evidence/escrow/no obligations needed.
- [ ] **BE-010** — Normal escrow release lacks provider movement; shared AUD-RQS00-0008; Sandbox release then callback reconciles seller net/fee/principal; rejection keeps held state.
- [ ] **BE-011** — Durable callback recovery and cancellation capture; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Replay/race/crash/unknown/cancelled success each resolves once; unprocessed funds appear in Console.
- [ ] **BE-012** — Verify ownership before provider lookup; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Unrelated reference denied with no provider lookup; authorised pending state correct.
- [ ] **BE-013** — Historical deletion and retention; shared AUD-RQS00-0021; Delete blocked with transaction/history; erasure retains legal evidence with audit and privacy.
- [ ] **BE-014** — Published-only project canonical counts and prices; shared AUD-RQS01-0009; Unapproved cheap unit cannot alter public range; no published units means no availability.
- [ ] **BE-015** — Import partial acceptance and idempotent restart; shared AUD-RQS02-0032; Duplicate confirm/crash after save/retry yields one unit per row; valid rows handled according to approved matrix.
- [ ] **BE-016** — Alerts respect frequency and full canonical criteria; shared AUD-RQS03-0049; Daily/weekly never delivered every tick; >20 same-time matches not lost; identical catalogue results.
- [ ] **BE-017** — Global sort before pagination and currency-normalised prices; shared AUD-RQS02-0037; Top item beyond page1 returned at correct rank, no duplicate/skip on stable snapshot.
- [ ] **BE-018** — Regex keyword semantics and bounded queries; shared AUD-RQS03-0005; Multiple keywords match across fields; unsafe regex rejected; out-of-page result found.
- [ ] **BE-019** — Plan completion atomicity on database topology; shared AUD-RQS01-0108; Standalone unsupported configuration fails safely; replica-set crash tests preserve ledger/state.
- [ ] **BE-020** — Proxy fee inclusion versus buyer surcharge; shared AUD-RQS06-0092; Buyer quoted gross equals charged gross; partner net/platform share/tax sum exact.
- [ ] **BE-021** — Hardcoded paid tour rate; shared AUD-RQS04-0045; Rate change effective-date snapshot; disabled charging rejected via API even if UI bypassed.
- [ ] **BE-022** — Independent launch Zoom adapter; shared AUD-RQS00-0003; Licensed organiser sandbox session for authorized seller/Inspection Partner; denied/expired/cancelled links fail.
- [ ] **BE-023** — Independent launch CloudPano adapter; shared AUD-RQS04-0043; Real licensed tour on approved domain, outage/bad-host path; no assumed unsupported dollhouse capability.
- [ ] **BE-024** — Matterport and Realsee production verification; shared AUD-RQS04-0043; Each provider authenticated licensed model/work tested independently; invalid/expired/provider-outage response safe.
- [ ] **BE-025** — Paid/free/on-request/private viewer gates; shared AUD-RQS06-0204; Direct GET cannot bypass Paid/Private; request approved scoped user only; no provider URL before access.
- [ ] **BE-026** — Review eligibility across sale flows and near-purchase; shared AUD-RQS03-0031; Escrow/instalment and failed-near-purchase fixtures produce correct eligibility and counts.
- [ ] **BE-027** — Correct role-specific trust source and tiers; shared AUD-RQS03-0030; Known role history yields approved score; insufficient history says New, no0.0; no paid score.
- [ ] **BE-028** — Contact blocking through all communication surfaces; shared AUD-RQS00-0002; Alternate formatting/attachments cannot exchange contact; provider session link allowed only issued safe route.
- [ ] **BE-029** — Durable notification abstraction and specified channels; shared AUD-RQS00-0003; One event per idempotency key; mandatory legal/security/payment preserved; failed channel retry no duplicate.
- [ ] **BE-030** — Runbook environment mismatch; shared AUD-RQS02-0027; Clean approved staging deployment uses documented key and safe startup/index process.
- [ ] **BE-031** — Historical load-test failures require realistic retest; shared AUD-RQS01-0107; Historical burst1 802/1000 successful,P95~28.9s; burst2 204/1000; burst3 797/1000 does not certify current launch. New evidence meets approved workload.
- [ ] **BE-032** — OIDC/global ID/outbox are launch foundations; shared AUD-RQS06-0345; Each launch event produced now; default-off subscriptions cannot transmit; test app two-officer activation/config works.
